title: Restriction of condensed derived exchange to one open
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be an arbitrary commutative condensed ring and use the ordinary internal-module derived operations [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull] in the small-site universe [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $X′\to X$, $X′\to Y′$, $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y′\to Y$ be a chosen Cartesian square [def-pc-fibre-product; def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange]. Let $v:U\to Y$ be an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]. Choose Cartesian presentations $X_U\to X$, $f_U:X_U\to U$ and $b:Y′_U\to Y′$, $g_U:Y′_U\to U$ over $v$, and any Cartesian square $h_U:X′_U\to X_U$, $f′_U:X′_U\to Y′_U$ over $f_U,g_U$. For every $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X})$, the exact inverse image $b^*$ of the actual ambient exchange at $K$ is invertible if and only if the exact-pullback adjunction exchange [def-sfb-closed-test-derived-exchange-maps] of the localized square is invertible at $a^*K$, where $a:X_U\to X$. No affine, closed, qcqs, proper, boundedness or constructibility assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Use the three Cartesian presentations to define the missing map t:XU′→X′. Pasting and cancellation give the remaining faces of the cube; base change makes a,b,t open immersions. This is the same projection-preserving cube construction as in ringed open restriction.

For each corner use the exact internal/section-module equivalence and its normalized upper and lower comparisons. An exact equivalence preserves K-injectives because its inverse is an exact left adjoint. Applying the lower comparison on K-injective representatives therefore gives the canonical right-derived comparison, while the upper comparison descends termwise. Their unit, counit and upper-composition identities descend from the ordinary identities, so these comparisons identify the actual derived mates. Total left inverse image is canonically the exact termwise inverse image, with the induced adjunction from the same ordinary adjunction; insert its canonical comparison before and after each mate.

Let α:b* g*≅gU* v*, β:b* Rf′_*≅RfU′_* t*, γ:v* Rf_*≅RfU_* a*, δ:t* g′*≅hU* a* be the canonical exact comparisons. Ringed open_restriction gives b*(Ex_K);β;RfU′_*(δ)=α;gU*(γ);Ex_U(a*K). Both open pushforward comparisons β,γ are invertible by open_comparison. The other comparisons are pullback-composition isomorphisms. Thus cancellation gives the equivalence of invertibility. Transport through the exact equivalences, which reflect isomorphisms, and the total-left/exact comparisons. No conservativity or covering family is used in this one-open calculation. Alternatively, the already stated derivedOpenRestrictionNormalization gives the canonical internal open direct-image isomorphisms β,γ directly; exchangeMate_cube gives the displayed equation after the inverse-image cube identity. The latter identity is pullback-composition coherence, transported through the canonical exact/total-left comparison. Thus no separate open direct-image isomorphism needs to be stated or reproved.

The project has RingedRestrictionExchange.open_restriction and open_comparison on section modules, and InternalModuleOperations.internal_module_operations_transport for ordinary operations. NonaffineClosedTestExchangeIdentification.actual_ambient_exchange only converts the exact/total-left mates on affine quotient closed squares; it does not compare different base opens. No existing internal-module one-open comparison. Blueprint search restriction exchange open returned zero matching blueprint nodes. A later search also found derivedOpenRestrictionNormalization (canonical internal open direct-image mate isomorphisms, not a full arbitrary-exchange restriction comparison) and exchangeMate_cube (abstract mate naturality). These give the alternative direct internal proof recorded in step 3.

theorem condensed_exchange_one_open_restriction
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    {X' X Y' Y U XU YU' XU' : Scheme.{u}}
    {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y}
    (sq : ChosenCartesianSquare g' f' f g)
    (v : U ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion v]
    (a : XU ⟶ X) (fU : XU ⟶ U)
    (b : YU' ⟶ Y') (gU : YU' ⟶ U)
    (hU : XU' ⟶ XU) (fU' : XU' ⟶ YU')
    (wf : IsPullback a fU f v) (wg : IsPullback b gU g v)
    (w : IsPullback hU fU' fU gU)
    (K : DerivedCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))) :
    IsIso ((upperStar Λ b).mapDerivedCategory.map ((condensedAmbientExchange Λ sq).app K)) ↔
      IsIso ((ClosedTestDerivedExchangeModel.exchange Λ w.toCommSq).app
        ((upperStar Λ a).mapDerivedCategory.obj K))
